images.alt: A laptop in the middle of the picture, ringed by six loose gears each sitting in its own tray, none connected. To the right a small server tower holds the same six gears meshed together as one block. A dotted line from the tower stops before reaching the ring.
images.prompt: A single open laptop sits at the centre of the frame. Its inference engine is drawn as an exploded diagram: six gear-shaped components float apart from each other in six separate outlined trays arranged in a loose ring around the laptop, none of them touching or meshed. To the right, well inside the frame, a small server tower shows the same six gears meshed together as one compact assembled block. A thin dotted line runs from the assembled block toward the scattered ring and stops short. Everything is kept away from the edges.
